definitions.full: H3946. Laqqum לַקּוּם proper name, of a location northern border-town of Naphtali , Josh 19:33 (P), ᵐ5 Δωδαμ , ᵐ5 L Λακουμ . so also Lag Onom 275, 24 ; site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification;

occurrences.englishText: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
